footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $695K income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 12.9% to $114M in 2025. Gross margin was 43.0%, versus 42.4% a year earlier, and the company had an operating loss of $3.7M, versus operating income of $3.4M.
The company had a net loss of $2.5M, or −$0.21 per share, versus net income of $2.9M. Operating cash flow was $7.3M and free cash flow $5.7M, versus $2.5M.
sources: InTest Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
